answer: Each identity must hold a licensed taxi driver permit, earned with a medical exam, a knowledge test and a background check costing about $90 per licence. A farm needs a distinct licensed driver per fake, so 1,000 fakes cost $90,000 plus weeks of testing each. The haven of cheap aliases empties: every fake adds another exam, the nebula of borrowed licences thins as duplicates fail checks, and the zephyr of scale turns into a queue of real drivers.
